The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Keyword-only, type-annotated <entity>_<action> service; validates; wraps multi-step writes in transaction.atomic
- Schedules the notification via transaction.on_commit so it fires only after commit
- Calls full_clean before save on constructed instances; no business logic left to the API

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
